payload.summary: Round-1 integrated implementation review did not converge. Codex, Claude, and Grok supplied schema-valid reviews (31 raw findings, 26 unique, 4 confirmed, 0 disagreements); consensus records 3 blocking findings, and independent deterministic review also exposed a due-deferral reversion, timezone-negative staleness, and legacy-record incompatibility that require remediation before validation.
completed_work: Dispatched read-only branch-wide implementation reviews to antigravity, claude_code, grok, and pi; Claude and Grok returned schema-valid findings, Antigravity returned malformed JSON, and Pi reported auth_required.
Combined the primary Codex review with two valid external reviews: 31 raw findings, 26 unique findings, 4 confirmed, 22 unconfirmed, and 0 disagreements.
Reproduced lifecycle failure with an unscored surviving stub, forced-cache timestamp rejection, and stale-manifest publication in isolated repositories.
Validated all successful findings documents and the normalized consensus report against repository schemas.
Preserved the complete vendor dispatch manifest, prompt, findings, and consensus under reviews/implementation/round-1/.

decisions.title: Return the implementation to IMPL_FIX
decisions.rationale: Confirmed critical failures can deadlock lifecycle maintenance after scoring degradation and make the required force-cache path unusable; additional deterministic critical findings can revert due deferrals or reject valid staleness/legacy state.

decisions.title: Drop Pi from later review rounds until credentials change
decisions.rationale: The round manifest classifies Pi as auth_required, which is account-scoped and must not be retried unchanged under Autopilot issue-383 policy.

next_steps: Allow lifecycle rebuilds to retain unscored store entries for later scoring instead of requiring caches for keys absent from the prior digest.
Normalize due decisions once and thread the maintained record through prepare-batch and rank so a scored cycle cannot restore an expired deferral.
Implement and test the no-dispatch forced same-fingerprint cache/digest reuse path.
Bind rank manifests to the current store or a validated dry-run overlay so stale candidate bytes cannot be published.
Normalize commit and host timestamps to UTC before date subtraction and cover offset-crossing commits.
Migrate legacy record fixtures and make durable-record sanitization produce schema-writable canonical decisions.
Define and test a zero-candidate fast path, and ensure post-recovery commands rehydrate or merge the recovered mirror before publishing new state.
Rerun focused supervise tests, strict OpenSpec validation, and a fresh IMPL_REVIEW round after fixes.
